name: ChatGPT Conversions API Plugins
description: Captures the OpenAI browser reference (obref) and oppref click ID in the browser and adds them to events for ChatGPT Conversions API.

chatgptConversionsApiPlugin.title: ChatGPT Conversions API Plugin
chatgptConversionsApiPlugin.description: Enriches Segment payloads with the ChatGPT Conversions API oppref querystring value and the __obref cookie value, so the ChatGPT Conversions API destination can send them. Segment does not check consent: you are responsible for loading this destination only when your measurement consent requirements allow reading the __obref cookie.
chatgptConversionsApiPlugin.defaultSubscription: type = "track" or type = "identify" or type = "page" or type = "group" or type = "alias"
